analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
SWEPT 2026-08-20: concept.sefirot_tree (label='Sefirot Tree', definition='The diagrammatic arrangement of the ten Sephirot...') and concept.sephirot_tree (label='Sephirot Tree', definition=None) — SequenceMatcher similarity 0.88.

Neither concept has any accepted or pending tags. concept.sephirot_tree has no definition at all (one of 5 undefined concepts: cosmic_order, kingdom_of_light, sephirot_tree, immortality, hope).

This is a clear merge candidate: same referent (the Kabbalistic Tree of Life), different transliteration spelling. After merge, all tags on either concept should re-point to the surviving ID.
